MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3.

3. A — newton (N)

4. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

5. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

7. D — Glucose and oxygen

8. D — Producers

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .

11. D — Ice melting to water

12. A — 100 °C
